summary: The newcomer invites a colleague to lunch instead of waiting to be asked.
realLife: First-week guidance says to look for a buddy or mentor and to invite coworkers to lunch rather than wait for an invitation. Follow-up questions about what the coworker just said read as more engaged.
sources: Atlassian Work Life, starting a new job and first week success: https://www.atlassian.com/blog/teamwork/starting-a-new-job-and-first-week-success
inGame: New-coworker event plus the person's tie to the player (coworker) and traits such as shy or outgoing; no lunch mechanic, so it needs: a meal or break scene hook. Scene: needs a producer for first-day-ropes.

turns.summary: The newcomer eats alone at the desk and waits for an invitation.
turns.writesBack: No tie forms yet, and the first week feels lonely.

turns.summary: The colleague already has plans or a lunch habit and politely declines.
pulledBy: a tie that is still thin
turns.writesBack: A small sting, and the newcomer tries someone else.

turns.summary: A colleague invites the newcomer before they can ask.
turns.writesBack: A friendly tie forms, and the newcomer owes a return lunch.
